values.note: Only sites 2 and 3 are rated 50/30 amp; the other 15 electric sites are 30 amp. Water at all sites, some on spigots shared between sites. No sewer at public sites.

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/wayne/recreation/iron-ridge-campground ('water available at all sites') + RIDB catalog: 002 and 003 at 50/30 amp, the other 15 STANDARD ELECTRIC at 30; recreation.gov (sites 9, 19-21, 23-27 share spigots, others individual water hookups), read 2026-10-31

values.note: 21 RV sites: 17 electric and 4 non-electric, back-in and rated 35-45 ft, except pull-through 31 at 25 ft. The other 11 are tent or walk-to sites.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/wayne/recreation/iron-ridge-campground ('total of 32 campsites (21 RV sites and 11 tent sites)') + RIDB catalog (reservable RV/TENT/TRAILER sites: 002-008, 010-018, 022 electric; 028, 030, 031, 034 non-electric; 45 ft, 013 35 ft, 031 pull-through 25 ft); hosts 001 and 029 not counted, read 2026-10-31

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/232903 (flush toilets, showers, drinking water, dump station on site), read 2026-10-31

values.note: The Forest Service says early spring to fall, and 'closed for the season and will reopen in spring 2027'. recreation.gov's calendar starts April 10, 2027. It also opens for deer gun season, Pine Knob Loop only and without water.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/wayne/recreation/iron-ridge-campground ('Open seasonally from early spring to fall'; 'Opens outside of normal camping season for deer gun season only... only the Pine Knob Loop is open for camping, but without water') + recreation.gov calendar April 2027 (first available 04-10), read 2026-10-31

values.note: First-come only during deer gun season. Check-in 2 PM, check-out 1 PM. Maximum 14 nights in a rolling 30 days.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/wayne/recreation/iron-ridge-campground (reservations up to 4 days prior, first-come within that window; 'No reservations are taken during the deer gun season, first-come-first serve only') + https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/232903 (14 in rolling 30; check-in 2 PM, out 1 PM), read 2026-10-31

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/wayne/recreation/iron-ridge-campground ($20 electric+water, $15 water only) + recreation.gov rates, rate season 2027-04-10 to 10-11: STANDARD ELECTRIC 20, STANDARD NONELECTRIC 15, read 2026-10-31

note: Wayne National Forest (USFS), Lake Vesuvius Recreation Area (Ironton RD). On a wooded ridge above the lake with a trail to the water (not lakefront). --Claude
